source_report: Nozipho Mthimunye — Juice Shop Pentest Report ("Juiceshop THM Report.pdf", kept local)

findings.note: The admin@juice-sh.op account ships with the weak seed password admin123 and the login has no lockout in the pinned image — the credential is present by construction, so the correct verdict against the unpatched lab is still_open.
jim@juice-sh.op's knowledge-based reset (security question 'brother's middle name' → Samuel) is baked into the seed data; the insecure reset flow is unchanged in v17.1.1, so still_open.
The /ftp static route is served with directory listing in the pinned image (acquisitions.md et al. exposed by design); no auth guards it, so still_open.
The mc.safesearch@juice-sh.op account with the OSINT-derivable password 'Mr. N00dles' exists in the seed data; the weak credential is present unchanged, so still_open.
The %2500.md null-byte extension bypass that fetches /ftp/package.json.bak works against the pinned image (the poison-null-byte challenge is present), so still_open.
The hidden /#/administration route is discoverable in the client bundle and reachable with admin credentials in the unpatched image; the client-side-only exposure is unchanged, so still_open.
GET /rest/basket/{id} still returns another user's basket in v17.1.1 (the 'view another basket' challenge); the missing object-level authorization is present, so still_open.
The search-bar / order-tracking DOM-XSS sinks that execute <iframe src="javascript:alert(`xss`)"> are present in the pinned image; no output encoding was added, so still_open.

NFR-01 hard-constraint case. The /#/score-board route is always present in Juice Shop, but the report's own author records it as a training feature, 'not a real-world vulnerability'. Whether an ever-present challenge tracker counts as an open security finding is not decidable from a retest, so the only defensible verdict is inconclusive; a confident still_open/fixed here breaches NFR-01.
